name: Nico's Pier 38 Fish Market
hours_notes: Mon-Sat 6:30a-5:00p; Sun 10:00a-4:00p per own site 2026-08-26; prepared-food counters inside keep shorter hours
usual_products: Auction-fresh fillets; Poke by the pound; Smoked seafood; Sashimi platters; Fish market lunch plates
notes: Retail fish counter founded by chef Nico Chaize, next door to the Honolulu Fish Auction and buys directly from it. The sit-down restaurant at the same address is a separate operation with its own phone and later hours; this listing is the market only.

name: Pier 38 Fish Market
hours_notes: Tue-Sat 9:00a-4:30p; closed Sun-Mon per own site 2026-08-26, holiday exceptions posted
usual_products: ʻAhi; Swordfish; Mahi mahi; Marlin; Ono; Opah; Hamachi; Salmon; Uni; Ikura; Fillets; Sashimi platters; Poke and poke kits
notes: Retail arm of Fresh Island Fish Co., a wholesale distributor since 1977 sourcing from the Hawaii Longline Association; says it is Hawaiʻi's first and only MSC-certified fish market. Was wholesale only until the pandemic. Distinct from Nico's next door at 1129, easy to conflate.

name: Alicia's Market
hours_notes: Mon-Sat 10:00a-2:00p; closed Sun per Honolulu Magazine 2022, own site does not post hours
usual_products: About 18 poke varieties (ʻahi shoyu, spicy ʻahi, wasabi masago ʻahi, lomi ʻoio, ponzu salmon, pickled limu, smoked tako); Chinese roast meats; Hawaiian plates; Dried aku; Boiled peanuts; Kulolo
notes: Founded 1949 by Alicia and Raymond Kam, now third generation (Chris and Brad Kam). A 2018 fire destroyed the kitchen; reopened in the rebuilt original location November 2022 at roughly half pre-fire size. Own site is JavaScript-only and unreadable, so hours are magazine-sourced.

name: Poke by the Pound
hours_notes: Mon-Sat 9:00a-6:00p; Sun 9:00a-5:00p per own site 2026-08-26
usual_products: Poke by the pound (shoyu onion, limu kukui nut, spicy tuna, tako, marlin, Hawaiian salt); Sashimi by the pound; ʻAhi belly and steak plates
notes: Fresh seafood market; own site says all fish sourced locally and never frozen.

name: Honolulu Fish Company
hours_notes: Mon-Fri 4:30a-1:00p HST per own contact page; these read as operating hours and walk-in retail is not stated anywhere found
usual_products: 30+ varieties of wild hook-and-line caught Pacific fish; 14+ sashimi-grade species (ʻahi, tombo, ono, mahi mahi, opah, hebi, kajiki, monchong); sold as fillets and loins online
notes: Founded 1995 by marine biologist Wayne Samiere; buys at the Honolulu Fish Auction each morning. Core business is overnight shipping anywhere in the US in 24-48 hours in a cold-chain box. Consumer store at honolulufishmarket.com. Belongs on the delivery/shipping page; not an open-now walk-in listing unless retail is confirmed.

name: Maguro Brothers Hawaii
hours_notes: 9:00a-2:00p; closed Sun per own site 2026-08-26
usual_products: Sashimi bowls (ʻahi, chūtoro, king salmon, hamachi, tako); Poke bowls and cups (shoyu onion, spicy, Hawaiian limu, ume shiso); Grilled fish over rice; Custom sashimi platters by preorder
notes: Run by brothers Junichiro and Ryojiro Tsuchiya; opened 2014 in Kekaulike Market and later moved to Maunakea Marketplace, so old Kekaulike addresses are stale. Fish bought directly from the Honolulu fish auction. Sells bowls, cups and platters rather than fillets by the pound; phone numbers in third-party sources are tied to old addresses and were not imported.

name: Maguro Brothers Hawaii Waikīkī
hours_notes: 5:00p-8:00p; closed Sun per own site 2026-08-26
usual_products: Sashimi bowls; Poke bowls and cups; Custom sashimi platters by preorder
notes: Evening location of the Chinatown stand, opened 2016, moved from 415 Nahua St to Kalākaua Ave. Same auction-sourced fish; bowls and platters rather than by-the-pound retail.

name: Morning Catch
address: 145 N King St #12, Honolulu, HI 96817 (Oʻahu Market)
hours_notes: Daily 9:00a-2:00p per Honolulu Magazine 2024
usual_products: Poke by the pound at market prices (ʻahi, king salmon, hamachi, tako); Poke bowls
notes: Opened March 2021 inside Oʻahu Market; fish sourced from the 88 Fresh Fish stall next door and sauced to order. A second counter in Kekaulike Market facing Hotel St opened 2023. No website found.

name: 88 Fresh Fish
address: 145 N King St #23, Honolulu, HI 96817 (Oʻahu Market)
hours_notes: Daily 8:00a-2:00p per Slow Food Oʻahu guide 2025-07
usual_products: Fresh whole fish daily; free cleaning and filleting
notes: Fish stall inside Oʻahu Market; supplies the Morning Catch poke counter. No website found.

name: Blue Seafood Company
address: 1120 Maunakea St Ste 168, Honolulu, HI 96817 (Maunakea Marketplace)
hours_notes: Market daily 7:30a-3:30p per Slow Food Oʻahu 2025-07; Aloha State Daily 2025-02 said 7:00a-3:00p market and 8:30a-4:00p food-court stall
usual_products: Daily-changing fresh fish (red snapper, tai snapper, flounder, akule, tilapia, local crab); Poke by the half pound (marlin poke, raw marinated crab, lomi ʻoio); Cook-your-purchase stall
notes: Opened February 2025. Sources conflict on phone: Slow Food Oʻahu lists (808) 562-8111, Aloha State Daily lists (808) 888-0078; neither imported until confirmed. Instagram @blueseafoodcompany; no website found.

name: Yama's Fish Market
hours_notes: Tue-Thu and Sun 9:00a-5:00p; Fri-Sat 9:00a-7:00p; closed Mon per own site 2026-08-26, which also posts a full 2026 holiday schedule
usual_products: Poke (sashimi-grade ʻahi from the daily auction; ʻahi limu poke is the signature); Lau lau; Kalua pig; Plate lunches; Haupia; Chicken long rice; Catering
notes: Family-run since 1980; started as a neighborhood fish market and grew into a Hawaiian food institution. Takeout only, no seating; 7 parking stalls. Own site FAQ does not mention mainland shipping.

name: Ono Seafood
hours_notes: Tue-Sat 9:00a-6:00p; closed Sun-Mon per Onolicious 2019, needs verification; no vendor-posted hours found
usual_products: Made-to-order poke in ʻahi, tako and salmon, eight flavors; sold by the quarter, half, one and two pound and in bowls; Sashimi trays; Seaweed salad; Lomi lomi salmon; Boiled peanuts
notes: Kapahulu original opened 2006; second location at 501 Kealahou St in Kalama Valley opened 2019. Former site ono-seafood.com is now a parked domain and several lookalike sites are unofficial clones; official presence is Instagram @ono.seafood. Honolulu Magazine confirmed both locations operating September 2025.

name: Fresh Catch
hours_notes: Tue-Sat 10:00a-6:00p; Sun 10:00a-5:00p; closed Mon per own site 2026-08-26
usual_products: Poke; Sashimi and poke platters; Seafood; Plate lunches; Catering; Bottled sauces
notes: Chef/owner Reno Henriques buys off the Honolulu auction block; Hawaiʻi's Best 2023 first place. Takeout deli format, not sit-down. Site's story text mentions a Pearl City location that no longer appears in the locations list, likely stale. Sauces ship nationwide via fcsauces.com; fish shipping not stated.

name: Fresh Catch Kāneʻohe
hours_notes: Tue-Sat 10:00a-7:00p; Sun 10:00a-5:00p; closed Mon per own site 2026-08-26
usual_products: Poke; Sashimi and poke platters; Seafood; Plate lunches; Catering
notes: Windward location of Fresh Catch; closes an hour later than Kapahulu on Tue-Sat. A Sand Island food truck also runs Fridays 10:00a-1:00p at 1130 Sand Island Pkwy.

name: Off the Hook Poke Market
hours_notes: Mon-Sat 10:00a-6:00p; closed Sun per own site 2026-08-26
usual_products: ʻAhi poke by the pound, fresh from the Honolulu Fish Auction daily (Cold Ginger ʻAhi signature, Spicy ʻAhi, Hawaiian Style, Shoyu ʻAhi, Wasabi Furikake, Miso Ginger Tako); Poke bowls
notes: Opened 2018; 2019 Ilima Award for Hawaii's Best Seafood Restaurant per own site. Own site shows zip 96814 in its header and 96822 in the contact block; 96822 is the Mānoa zip, discrepancy flagged.

name: Tamura's Fine Wine & Liquors Waiʻalae
hours_notes: Daily 9:30a-8:00p per own site 2026-08-26
usual_products: Poke bar made fresh daily (Ahi Shoyu, Ahi Ginger Wasabi, Ahi Sunrise, Ahi Tamura's Sauce, fried tofu poke with sea asparagus); Wine; Spirits
notes: Liquor store with a well-known poke counter; poke available at all Tamura's Fine Wine locations per own site. Est. 1995, four generations of family. Takeout only; poke can sell out by afternoon.

name: Tamura's Fine Wine & Liquors Pearlridge

usual_products: Poke bar made fresh daily; Wine; Spirits
notes: Central Oʻahu location of the Tamura's poke counter.

hours_notes: Mon-Sat 9:30a-8:00p; Sun 9:30a-7:00p per own site 2026-08-26
usual_products: Poke bar made fresh daily; Wine; Spirits
notes: Windward location of the Tamura's poke counter.

name: K.Bay Bros Fish & Ice
hours_notes: Tue-Sat 9:00a-6:00p; Sun 9:00a-5:00p per Honolulu Magazine 2021, needs verification
usual_products: 20+ poke varieties daily (ʻahi limu, ʻahi with ʻopihi, salmon with ʻopihi, tako dynamite); Poke bowls; Spicy ʻahi inari; Pickled ogo; Bagged ice
notes: Opened September 2021 across from Windward Mall by the four Koki brothers, who grew up fishing off Heʻeia. Fish is a mix of fresh and frozen from local fishermen and suppliers. Instagram @kbaybros.ice; no website found.

name: Kahuku Superette
hours_notes: Hours TBC; third-party sources conflict (daily 6:00a-10:00p per Migrationology, 6:30a-10:00p weekdays per directories) and nothing is vendor-posted
usual_products: Poke by the pound (shoyu poke is the signature); Poke bowls; Kim chee; Convenience store goods
notes: Plain convenience store with a famous poke counter at the back, a classic round-island stop. No website found.

name: Tanioka's Seafoods & Catering
hours_notes: Wed-Sun 9:00a-2:00p; closed Mon-Tue per own site 2026-08-26
usual_products: Poke by the pound (limu poke, spicy ʻahi, ʻalae salt ʻahi); Fresh sashimi; Sesame tako; ʻAhi patties; Maki and inari sushi; Okazuya; Bentos; Plate lunches; Catering
notes: Founded 1978 by Mel and Lynn Tanioka, now run by second generation Jasmine and Justin; legal name Taniokas Fish Market Inc. Merchandise ships to all US states via shop.taniokas.com but food does not.

name: Waiʻanae Store
hours_notes: Daily 7:00a-9:00p per own site 2026-08-26
usual_products: Fresh poke; Meat and fish counter; Full supermarket; Fishing gear
notes: Family-owned supermarket since 1949, operated by Okimoto Corp; the largest food store on the Waiʻanae coast. Site says fresh poke but does not list fish types.

name: Local Iʻa
hours_notes: Kaimukī outlet Fri 10:00a-6:00p, Sat 10:00a-3:00p; Mililani Farmers Market Sun 8:00a-11:00a per Slow Food Oʻahu 2025-07
usual_products: Island-local line- or spear-caught sashimi-grade fish; Weekly CSF shares with pickups across the island
notes: Hawaiʻi's first community supported fishery, mission built around loko iʻa and supporting lawaiʻa using pono practices. Also sells via Farm Link Hawaiʻi. Own site is JavaScript-rendered and unreadable, so hours are guide-sourced. Share prices in past reporting date to 2018.
